title: Pull-to-refresh and stretch overscroll
blurb: Recreate Android 12+ non-uniform UV stretch overscroll and a liquid metaball pull-to-refresh droplet inside one WebGL 2 canvas holding a live scrollable HTML feed.
question: Can I recreate Android 12+ non-uniform stretch overscroll and a gooey liquid-metaball pull-to-refresh droplet inside a single WebGL 2 canvas holding a live scrollable HTML feed, keeping interactive items clickable and overscroll-behavior-y: contain intact?
result: Measured in headless Chrome 160 Canary (2026-11-27): one ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas uploads the live scrollable feed via texElementSubImage2D(), stretches UVs non-uniformly (+77.8% near y = 0, -2.3% near y = 1 at 96 px pull), snaps a 2D metaball droplet past 78 px to prepend a fresh DOM row, and keeps scrolled buttons clickable via updateElementGeometry() scaled by geometryUnit(). Not verified on Chrome 159 for Android yet.
